layout.footerNote: Validation and the engine run on the server — the UI does not duplicate business rules.

fileDrop.dragHere: Drag and drop the file here

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong in the UI
errorBoundary.fallback: Unexpected error while rendering this screen.

apiErrors.timeout: The API did not respond in time. Check that it is running and reachable, then try again.
apiErrors.unreachable: Could not reach the API. Check that it is running and reachable, then try again.

home.title: Threat modeling, step by step
home.description: Canonical model validated on the server, STRIDE engine with references to standards (OWASP, NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and exportable artifacts — built for teams that need technical evidence, not just diagrams.
home.contextHintStrong: Validation and analysis run in the backend
home.contextHintTail: — the UI orchestrates the flow; rules and engine do not run in the browser.
home.why1: Import with explicit inferences — review before running the engine.
home.why2: Semantic diff between model versions (structure + optional analysis).
home.why3: Export aligned to the canonical document — suitable for CI and peer review.
home.mvpAlert: This MVP keeps the draft locally in the browser (current session). Export the result to keep a persistent artifact.
home.startSubtitle: Three common entry points — the same canonical base in every case.
home.flowOneLiner: Import or create → wizard → diagram → analysis → export or diff between revisions.
home.sessionCardSubtitle: Resume where you left off when a model already exists.
home.hasDoc: You already have a model loaded.
home.noDoc: No active model — use “Create new model”, import, or a template to start.

workflow.pipelineDesc: From artifact to report: each step validates or enriches the model on the server before analysis.

quickStart.blankDesc: API creates the canonical document; edit in the wizard.

import.title: Import artifact
import.description: Generates a canonical <0>draft</0> with explicit inferences. It does not replace review or threat analysis.
import.contextAfterDraft: After the draft, use the <0>wizard</0> to adjust IDs and flows before the engine.
import.alertResult: The result includes likely components and flows. Check the inference list before going to <0>analysis</0>.
import.cardSubtitle: The file is processed on the server; nothing is persisted in the API (MVP).
import.toastImported: Draft imported. Review inferences before analysis.
import.toastFail: Failed to send to the server.
import.inferencesSubtitle: Transparency — each line explains the assistant’s reasoning.
import.jsonContractBody: Useful for reports and API: the <0>explanations</0> field mirrors inferences with type and category.

wizard.title: Wizard
wizard.description: Four short steps. IDs must be unique (letters, numbers, <0>_</0> and <1>-</1>).
wizard.helpNextBody: Complete the steps and validate — then open the <0>diagram</0> and <1>analysis</1> when the model is coherent.
wizard.semanticProfileBody: Fill if you use a gallery template or want to unlock adaptive questions. For example <0>internal_admin_portal</0>, <1>file_handling_application</1>, <2>api_backend_rest</2>.
wizard.adaptiveBody: Answers are stored as tags on the model (JSON export includes them). They do not replace server validation.
wizard.idTrailingWhitespace: IDs cannot end with whitespace. Remove anything after the last visible character.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.flowsSubtitle: Connections between components (source and destination = component IDs).
wizard.flowIdRenameHint: When you change the ID and leave this field, references in assets, trust boundaries, and threats update automatically (if the new ID is valid and unique).
wizard.flowNameHint: Free text: accents, spaces, and symbols are allowed (this is not the technical identifier).
wizard.reviewBody: Validate on the server and continue to the components and flows view. You can return to any step to adjust.
wizard.contextSummaryBody: These answers are sent to the engine as <0>wz:</0> tags and influence ranking and anti-patterns in an explainable way.
wizard.validationFail: The model did not pass validation. Fix required fields.

methodologyHints.stride: STRIDE: prioritize components, flows, trust boundaries, and minimum identifiable assets.
methodologyHints.pasta: PASTA: reinforce business objectives, impact, assets, and critical integrations in the model text.
methodologyHints.nist_data_centric: NIST data-centric: data classification, data paths, and protection in transit/at rest/in use.
methodologyHints.default: Choose the methodology aligned with context; the engine evaluates fit on the server.

review.title: Logical diagram
review.description: Visual editor (React Flow) with editing enabled by default: drag nodes, connect components, use Delete. “View” disables structural edits. The list below reflects the session model.
review.validMeta: Valid · schema {{schema}} · {{components}} components · {{threats}} threats in document
review.diagramCardSubtitle: Default: Edit (drag, connect, delete, labels). “View” = read-only.
review.trustSubtitle: Inference notes, crossing flows, and manual validation (without editing JSON).

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: STRIDE engine, trust boundaries, and risk (L×I). Framework references come from the server.
analysis.contextHint: The engine runs on the server with the current document; then you can export or compare versions in diff.
analysis.contextHintRich: The engine runs on the server with the current document; then you can <0>export</0> or compare versions in <1>diff</1>.
analysis.emptyDescRich: Confirm the model in the wizard and diagram, choose methodology, and use <0>Run analysis</0> to get STRIDE heuristics, L×I metrics, and framework references — all computed on the server.
analysis.emptyDesc: Confirm the model in the wizard and diagram, choose methodology, and use Run analysis to get STRIDE heuristics, L×I metrics, and framework references — all computed on the server.
analysis.toastOk: Analysis generated. Review metrics and threats below.

stride.hint: Default technical choice, most mature for web/API/cloud.

linddun.hint: Privacy: PII, consent, minimization, and compliance.

nist_data_centric.hint: Protection of critical data and sensitive paths.

runEngine.title: Run engine
runEngine.subtitle: Methodology, optional pack, and engine execution.
runEngine.overrideHint: You can recommend automatically and still override manually.
runEngine.packEmptyHint: Leave empty for analysis with base heuristics only.

metrics.riskCaption: Highest L×I calculated in this run.

decisionCockpit.bandLine: Model in band <0>{{band}}</0> (pre-check {{score}}/100). Recommendation confidence: <1>{{conf}}</1>. Use <2>Compare</2> or <3>Export</3> below for stakeholder evidence.
decisionCockpit.runEngineHint: Run the engine to get pre-check, priorities, and gaps with context.
decisionCockpit.title: Decision cockpit
decisionCockpit.noGaps: No critical gaps listed by the pre-check.
decisionCockpit.noWizardSignals: No wizard signals — fill the adaptive questionnaire for context.
decisionCockpit.antiPatternHits: {{count}} relevant modeling anti-pattern(s) for the template.

plot4ai.subtitle: Heuristic detection from the model; does not replace architecture review.

threatsCard.title: Suggested threats
threatsCard.subtitle: Filter by score or framework catalog.

explanations.sectionBody: Structured reasons from the engine (max. 8 lines; full JSON has the rest).

remediation.title: Remediation backlog (suggested)
remediation.subtitle: Heuristic prioritization with rationale — not a task manager.

export.title: Export
export.description: Generates files in the browser. Formats that include analysis use the latest session result; if missing, the server runs the engine automatically.
export.contextHint: Formats with analysis use the latest session result; diff compares exported JSON with another revision.
export.formatsSubtitle: Select what you need for reporting or integration.
export.premiumSubtitle: Executive / Standard / Deep — Markdown or PDF aligned with engine and backlog (requires API running).
export.premiumNote: If there is no session analysis, the API runs the engine automatically. The PDF uses the same pipeline as the CLI.
export.pdfCardSubtitle: Generated in the browser (jsPDF) — model and session analysis, no extra API call.
export.pdfCardBody: Includes title, summary, metrics, and threats (sample). Plain text content for safe reading.
export.downloadSubtitle: Files ready for archive or review.
export.copyPreview: You can also copy from the technical preview below.

artifactPdf.noAnalysis: Analysis not available in this report.

diff.title: Diff between versions
diff.description: The baseline is the current session model. Paste or load the revision as JSON (same format as <0>document_json export). The server returns structural semantic diff, aggregates, and — if requested — analysis deltas.
diff.helpBody: The current session is the baseline. Paste exported JSON as revision to compare structural evolution and, optionally, engine deltas.
diff.readFail: Could not read the selected file.
diff.includeAnalysis: Include analysis (runs engine for both documents on the server)
diff.toastFail: Failed to request comparison from the API.
diff.riskCaption: Quick read of peak risk in the revision.
diff.interpretationNote: v1.5: each link includes why (<0>anchoring_rationale). <1>medium only with ≥2 lexical tokens; topic = <2>low. No proven causality.
diff.structureNote: Correlational references (ref:struct:*). They do not imply proven causality between change and incident.

history.title: History
history.description: Snapshots of recent analyses and exports (localStorage, max 20). Each entry shows metrics and a readable JSON summary. Restore replaces the model and analysis in session.
history.emptyDesc: Run analysis or generate export / PDF to create entries here.
history.confirmRestore: Restoring this snapshot replaces the current model and analysis in the session. Continue?
history.confirmExport: Restore and open the export page with this snapshot?
history.toastSession: Session updated. Choose formats in Export.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Each option generates a canonical document ready to edit in the wizard. Use filters to narrow the list without losing context.
templates.emptyResultsDesc: Adjust the filter or search text. Templates are starting points — they do not replace full modeling.

approval.label: Are there privileged actions that require explicit approval?
approval.hint: Segregation of duties and approval flows.

segregation.label: Is there clear segregation between admins and end users?

jit.label: Are there just-in-time privileges or temporary elevation?

quarantine.label: Is there a quarantine or isolated zone before processing?

scan.label: Antivirus, sandbox, or content revalidation after upload?

public_objects.label: Are stored objects exposed publicly (public URLs)?

auth.label: Are authentication and authorization explicitly modeled for clients?

edge_controls.label: Are cache, WAF, or strong perimeter policies represented at the gateway?

checkout.label: Does the checkout and payment flow have clear contextual controls?

psp_boundary.label: Is the payment processor (PSP) modeled as a third party with an adequate boundary?

sensitive_data.label: Are sensitive data (account, order, payment) covered by assets and classification?
